description: Download a file's content from Google Drive. Returns the text content for text files, or a base64-encoded string for binary files. For Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, exports to a readable format (plain text by default).

exportMimeType.description: For Google-native files (Docs/Sheets/Slides): export format. Defaults to text/plain for Docs, text/csv for Sheets. Examples: text/plain, text/csv, application/pdf

savePath.description: For binary files (images, PDFs): save to this local path instead of returning content inline. The file path is returned in the response.

name: drive_files_download
